title: Close Encounters
theme: Extreme close-ups, alien visitors and character meet-and-greets
intro: [excited] Get close, everybody. Closer. CLOSER! Tonight is Close Encounters: super zoomed-in pictures, visitors from outer space and face-to-face character meetings. [laughs] Squint hard. Buzz early!

art.prompt: A giant brass magnifying glass hovering over a twinkling miniature theme park at night, a flying saucer glowing in the starry sky above, beams of light everywhere Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

categories.title: Ride Close-Ups
categories.intro: Our Parks category starts super zoomed in on a real photo and slowly pulls back. [chuckles] Name the ride or attraction!

art.prompt: Extreme close-up of shiny attraction details: a riveted rocket hull, a mine-train wheel, a spooky iron gate and a rotating theater gear, all under dramatic spotlights Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Zoom out: this beam-riding train has carried guests around Walt Disney World since 1971. Name it.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Monorail! Please stand clear of the doors. [laughs] Por favor, manténgase alejado de las puertas!

clues.clue: Zoom out: this white, cone-shaped coaster blasted off into the dark at Magic Kingdom in 1975. Name it.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Space Mountain! [gasps] It's a roller coaster almost completely in the dark. Your snacks will not survive.

clues.clue: Zoom out: red rock spires and a runaway mine train. It's 'the wildest ride in the wilderness.' Name it.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Big Thunder Mountain Railroad! Hang on to your hats and glasses! [laughs] Seriously, hang on to them.

clues.clue: Zoom out: 999 happy haunts live here, and there's room for a thousand. Name the attraction.
clues.reveal: [whispers] The correct answer is the Haunted Mansion! Any volunteers? [chuckles] Your Doom Buggy is waiting.

clues.clue: Zoom out: this rotating theater show debuted at the 1964 New York World's Fair and moved to Magic Kingdom in 1975. Name it.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Walt Disney's Carousel of Progress! There's a great big beautiful tomorrow. [sighs] And the same dad has been telling us about it for decades.

categories.title: Snack Close-Ups
categories.intro: Zoomed-in movie food! [laughs] Don't lick the screen. Name the film this dish comes from.

art.prompt: Extreme macro close-up of a fancy dinner table: a shiny red apple, steaming pasta, powdered pastries and a neatly layered vegetable dish under warm candlelight Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Zoom out: one shiny red apple that's a little too perfect. Name the 1937 film.
clues.answer: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
accept: snow white and the seven dwarfs
choices: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs! One bite and it's a sleeping death. [whispers] Maybe stick to bananas.

media.prompt: Extreme close-up of a single glossy perfect red apple on a rustic wooden table, a faint green swirl reflected in the skin, a dark cottage window behind Original illustration, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Zoom out: a plate of spaghetti and meatballs by candlelight behind an Italian restaurant. Name the film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Lady and the Tramp! [laughs] One noodle, two dogs, and the most famous accidental kiss in movie history.

media.prompt: Close-up of a plate of spaghetti and meatballs on a red-checkered tablecloth in a back alley, a candle in a wine bottle, an accordion leaning nearby, moonlit night Original illustration, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Zoom out: a plate of golden, powdered-sugar beignets in New Orleans. Name the film.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is The Princess and the Frog! Tiana's beignets are so good they win over Big Daddy. [chuckles] You can get them at the parks too.

media.prompt: Close-up of a plate of square golden beignets heaped with powdered sugar on a cafe table, wrought-iron balconies and a riverboat blurred in the background Original illustration, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Zoom out: thin vegetable slices fanned in a perfect spiral that melts a tough food critic's heart. Name the film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Ratatouille! [sighs] One bite sends Anton Ego right back to his childhood. Chef Thomas Keller helped design the dish.

media.prompt: Close-up of a beautifully plated spiral of thinly sliced zucchini, eggplant and tomato on a white plate, a single sprig of herbs on top, elegant Paris bistro lighting Original illustration, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Zoom out: a plump steamed dumpling that comes to life for a lonely mom. Name this Oscar-winning 2018 Pixar short.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Bao! Directed by Domee Shi, it played before Incredibles 2 and won the Oscar for animated short. [laughs] Now I'm hungry.

categories.title: Tiny Details
categories.intro: These are super zoomed-in shots of famous movie props. [whispers] Buzz in before it's obvious!

art.prompt: Macro close-up collage of tiny movie-prop textures: brass gears, a seashell, colorful balloon strings, a rusty boot and a glowing sphere Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Zoom out: thousands of balloons lifting a little house into the sky. Name the Pixar film.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Up! Carl tied over ten thousand balloons to his house. [laughs] Paradise Falls or bust!

media.prompt: Thousands of colorful balloons on strings lifting a small old-fashioned clapboard house with a chimney into a bright blue sky over a city Original illustration, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Zoom out: a sword stuck in an anvil on a stone. Whoever pulls it out becomes king. Name the film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Sword in the Stone! [chuckles] Young Arthur, nicknamed Wart, pulls it out just to get a sword for his foster brother.

media.prompt: An ornate sword plunged into an iron anvil resting on a large stone in a snowy medieval churchyard, a beam of light shining down on it Original illustration, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Zoom out: a fork resting among seashells, treasure that a gull calls a 'dinglehopper.' Name the film.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is The Little Mermaid! Scuttle says it's for combing your hair. [chuckles] Do not take grooming advice from a seagull.

clues.clue: Zoom out: one small green plant growing inside an old boot on a trash-covered Earth. Name the film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is WALL-E! [gasps] That little plant proves Earth can grow life again. The whole Axiom heads home because of it.

clues.clue: Zoom out: a golden sphere that projects a glowing 3D star map of the galaxy. Name this 2002 film.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Treasure Planet! It's Treasure Island in outer space, with solar-sail galleons. [chuckles] Arrr, matey, in zero gravity.

categories.title: Alien Encounters
categories.intro: [gasps] Close encounters of the Disney kind! Visitors from outer space, in the films and in the parks.

art.prompt: A glowing flying saucer hovering over a quiet tropical beach at night, a beam of light shining down on the sand, palm trees and stars Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: In Toy Story, the little green aliens at Pizza Planet worship this machine.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is the Claw! Ooooh. The claw is our master. The claw chooses who will go and who will stay.

clues.clue: Before he was named Stitch, Jumba's blue alien creation was known as Experiment this number.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 626! [chuckles] Built to destroy, adopted by a little girl in Hawaii. Ohana means family!

clues.clue: In this 2005 film, a small bird warns his town that the sky is falling, and aliens turn out to be real.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Chicken Little! It was Disney's first fully computer-animated film from its own feature animation studio. [laughs] The sky really was falling!

clues.clue: This one-eyed alien 'Earth expert' from Lilo & Stitch loves to dress up as a human woman.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Pleakley! He says mosquitoes are an endangered species. [chuckles] They're not.

clues.clue: In 2004, Stitch's Great Escape replaced this scary Tomorrowland attraction that opened at Magic Kingdom in 1995.
clues.reveal: [whispers] The correct answer is the ExtraTERRORestrial Alien Encounter! It was so scary that kids ran out crying. [gasps] Stitch took its place, and the creepy theater stayed.

categories.title: Meet and Greet
categories.intro: [excited] The best close encounter is meeting a character face to face! Our fan category is all about character meetings in the parks.

art.prompt: A cheerful park plaza with a velvet rope line, a spot marked on the floor with a star, an open autograph book and a pen, balloons in the background Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Kids carry this kind of book through the parks to collect character signatures.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is an autograph book! Some characters have very fancy signatures. [chuckles] Goofy's handwriting is a lot.

clues.clue: Opened in 2013 in Magic Kingdom's Fantasyland, this hall is where guests meet princesses. Name it.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Princess Fairytale Hall! [excited] It took the place of Snow White's Scary Adventures. A big upgrade for royalty!

clues.clue: At Disney's Contemporary Resort, you can eat with Mickey and friends at this restaurant named for a famous chef.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Chef Mickey's! [chuckles] Breakfast with Mickey and the monorail gliding by overhead. Doesn't get more Disney than that.

clues.clue: In which EPCOT World Showcase pavilion can you dine with princesses at Akershus Royal Banquet Hall?
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Norway! Princess storybook dining inside a medieval-style castle hall. [laughs] Meatballs and tiaras, my favorite combo.

clues.clue: Under Magic Kingdom, characters travel through hidden tunnels so they never appear in the wrong land. Name the tunnels.
clues.reveal: [whispers] The correct answer is the Utilidors! Short for utility corridors. [gasps] Magic Kingdom is technically on the second floor!
